analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see stance for the past two consecutive trading days. RSI entered oversold territory at 44.8, and MACD histogram continued to worsen at -1.4985. ADX is at 19.9, indicating a non-trending phase. The current price of $352.84 is 4.4% above the swing support at $337.24 and 0.7% below the swing resistance at $355.39. Located at the lower end of the 52-week range at 27.5%. Considering the volatility (ATR $12.50 or 3.54%), a stop loss of 1.3x ATR ($16.25) would set the stop at $336.59, and a target of 2.6x ATR ($32.50) would set the target at $369.09. The risk-reward ratio of 1.99 meets the 1.5 minimum requirement. However, due to the non-trending phase and continued MACD deterioration, a buy entry is postponed.
